llm_response.reason: The website exhibits almost all major investment scam characteristics: it promises unrealistically high returns (up to 480% ROI), relies on unsubstantiated testimonials, pushes urgency and psychological triggers, does not provide valid business contact info or company verification, and uses unusual payment methods (cryptocurrency-only). The domain is very recently registered and deployed as a subdomain, a typical pattern in scam infrastructure. These traits collectively strongly indicate an Investment Scam.
